summary: WebRTC test coverage and audio parameter behavior were improved: tests were hardened to check connection state before comparing SDP descriptions and to verify remote candidate port restrictions, and there was an attempt to reduce flakiness in setParameters audio tests. Also, RTCRtpEncodingParameters.active was hooked up for audio, so applications can enable/disable individual audio encodings (useful for layered/variant streams or bandwidth adaptation). These updates make audio encoding control and test reliability better.
